Explore it or watch it

From your walk to their browser.

One space, four steps. You walk it with the phone; Veylet builds and checks the walkthrough automatically; nothing is shared until you approve it.

  1. Walk the space with the phone upright. At each spot, turn until the ring closes; the app flags anything it still needs before you finish.

  2. Tap Finish & save and read the phone check, then tap Send to Veylet. Send from the app: it uploads in the background. Check your account for rendering status.

  3. Veylet builds and checks it automatically and emails you when it’s ready: rooms that did not record are named for a recapture, anything else worth a look is flagged for you, and a capture that cannot be used is never counted.

  4. When it says Ready for your review, check that exact version on your phone and tap Approve and share: you get a link, a QR code and a website embed that open with no app or account, your account counts the opens, and turning off sharing stops new access.

Before you write.

What does a walkthrough cost?

1 free month from the day you activate the plan, with 30 rooms included; the first charge is on the day it ends, and cancelling before then charges nothing. Then the Veylet plan, monthly or yearly. Monthly is A$139.99 a month in the App Store, with 30 rooms a month; halls, stairs and connecting spaces are free with up to 2 standing spots (how rooms are counted), and unused rooms carry over, up to 40 banked. Yearly is A$1,399.99 upfront a year in the App Store: the same 360 rooms a year, to use any time in the plan year, for A$279.89 (16.7%) less than 12 monthly payments. Top-up packs for busier months aren’t on sale yet. One account for now (shared office accounts come after launch); hosting, link and embed are included, and every released walkthrough stays live while you subscribe. If your first walkthrough isn’t listing-ready, we redo it free. App Store subscriptions renew unless cancelled through Apple; studio invoices follow your written agreement. The offer page itemises your first year, and what a 3D tour costs in Australia compares photographer and camera prices. Joining the waitlist is free.

Can I see a real customer example?

We do not yet have a client-accepted tour to show. Our captures are still under quality review. The room images and animations here are labelled illustrations. Veylet support can tell you what has been tested so far.

Does joining the waitlist create an account or take payment?

No. Joining the waitlist creates no account and takes no payment. Anyone can join the waitlist; new accounts are admitted in weekly groups and sign in with the email they joined with.
